core.name: Guardian Shield and Impassioned Aria
core.text:
Some of her skills give every squad member a Guardian Shield based on her initial Max HP for 15s; new shields stack the value and extend it (up to 60s, and at most 12% of her initial Max HP). Each shield puts the Agent in Impassioned Aria: DMG +25% for 20s.
Her Special Attack: Off-Field sends her out for 80s of Off-Field Guard, where Aftershocks build Entry Points (max 140). At 120 she can come back in with her Entry Skill: Starshine Moment, which uses 120.
The Entry Skill, Ultimate, Counter Assist and Chain Parry each give 1 Buff Enhance Point (max 1); her next Off-Field Guard uses it to raise its DEF bonus and cap by 25%.
She recovers 15 Energy when a squad member triggers Maim.

ability.name: Rhythmic Resonance
ability.text: With an Armorer or Stun squadmate: +3,000 Decibels on entering battle (once every 600s in Investigation Zones), and ATK up for every Stun Agent in the squad, scaling with Robin's level (+80, rising by 12 per level up to +800 in the beta).

mindscapes: Her Entry Skill gives 2 Defense Points (max 2; 2 more on entering battle): when a shielded Agent takes more DMG than the shield holds, one blocks the excess. Each Buff Enhance Point used makes the squad's DMG ignore 20% of enemy DEF for 80s.
Aftershocks make the squad's DMG ignore 15% of enemy RES for 20s.
